👩🏻人気K-POPグループBTSが訪れた場所が、新たな観光地になっています。
江原道春川で軍服務中のBTSのVが、春川のあちこちで撮った写真をSNSに公開しました。
伝統市場の活性化を準備していた春川市は、これを積極的に活用することにしました。

👩🏻○○記者の報道です。

🗣軍服姿の男性が写った一枚の写真。
春川で軍服務中の世界的グループBTSのVです。春川出身の小説家、金裕貞（キム・ユジョン）の代表作『椿の花』の壁画が背景になっているのは、春川を代表する五日市の風物市場です。

同じ背景の写真ですが、人物が変わっています。

春川市長のユク・ドンハン氏です。

Vがこの2枚の写真を自身のSNSに投稿すると、市長はVに感謝の言葉を伝えましたが、反響は熱いです。

▶ インタビュー：ユク・ドンハン/ 江原道春川市長
👦🏻Vの威力を実感しました。この出来事をきっかけに、私達の伝統市場である風物市場が文化的・観光的な側面でさらに注目されることを期待しています。

市が立たない日には閑散としている風物市場ですが、BTSのVの訪問効果を活用することになりました。

BTSが訪れた場所にはファンの訪問が増え、名所となったために、伝統市場を観光地にすると言う事です。

▶ インタビュー : チェ・ジスク/ 春川市 市場商店街チーム長
🙎‍♀️BTSのVが写真を撮った場所を確認しながら、既存の飲食店で食事をしたり、お土産を購入していく人が増えています。

🗣昨年、文化観光型の特化市場育成事業の公募を通じて確保した10億ウォンの予算で、Vのフォトゾーンを設置し、外国人向けのフリーマーケットや蚤の市を開催する予定です。

また、駅やターミナルが近いことを活かし、観光客の舌を満足させるグルメを開発し、夜市も育成する計画です。

BTS 제이홉·슈가, 산불 피해 성금 각 1억원 기부
#방탄소년단 #BTS #제이홉 #jhope #슈가 #SUGA 
#산불피해성금 #1억원 #기부 #피해지원 #iMBC연예 

27일 소속사 빅히트 뮤직은 제이홉과 슈가가 울산·경북·경남 지역의 산불 피해 지원을 위한 성금을 기부했다고 밝혔다. 이들은 소속사를 통해 "길어지고 있는 산불 상황이 하루빨리 마무리되길 바란다. 

삶의 터전을 잃고 어려움을 겪는 분들과 진화 작업에 힘쓰고 계신 모든 분들이 빠르게 평온한 일상으로 돌아가시길 기원한다. 이번 기부가 조금이나마 위로와 희망이 되길 바란다"고 전했다.

제이홉은 희망브리지 전국재해구호협회에 성금 1억 원을 기탁했다. 성금은 재난 긴급 구호, 재난 이후 지역공동체 회복, 재난 취약계층 지원 등에 활용될 예정이다. 

슈가는 대한적십자사를 통해 성금 1억 원을 기부했다. 기부금은 산불로 피해를 입은 주민들에게 필요한 식음료 및 생필품 지원에 사용될 계획이다.

Full Text:
EXO CHANYEOL donates 30 million won to the Korean Animal Welfare Association on World Puppy Day 🤍

This donation was made with the proceeds from the sales of the character MD related to Chanyeol’s pet dog, and it is more meaningful because it was donated under the name of EXO’s official fan club, "EXO-L".

The Korean Animal Welfare Association announced on the 24th that Chanyeol donated 30 million won. The entire donation will be used to provide prescription feed for animals rescued from critical situations.

The Korean Animal Welfare Association is a civic group that rescues, protects, and adopts animals in critical conditions, and is protecting around 400 animals rescued from these situations such as abuse or neglect. Chanyeol’s donation will be used to provide prescription feed so that the rescued animals can recover their health and live stable lives.

This is not the first time Chanyeol has done good deeds. Since his debut in 2012, he has been consistently volunteering and supporting, taking the lead in spreading good influence. Based on his interest and love for companion dogs, he has also been actively participating in volunteer activities to help abandoned dogs and cats together with SM Entertainment executives and employees since 2024. Jo Heekyung, head of the Korean Animal Federation Association, said, “It is thanks to people like Chanyeol and EXO-L who extend a helping hand with warm hearts that rescued animals can heal and live a new life. In particular, the good deeds of influential artists will serve as a catalyst to lead to more good deeds."

Full Text:
Happy 25th Birthday to the gorgeous, hugely talented Rapper, Singer, Song-writer, Dancer, Actor, TV host, Top Model, Superstar and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One and Only #Hyunjin!👏🎂🎉🌟🐐👑🤍
#Hyunjin found fame as the main dancer, rapper, vocalist and visual genius of the chart-topping, record-breaking, history-making Iconic Band #StrayKids, the Biggest selling K-Pop Act currently in the US! He is one of the World's Best Dancers and has the most amazing voice and has contributed greatly to Stray Kids global success both as a performer and lyricist! He is the 4th most accredited song-writer of the group, after Stray Kids' production team, 3RACHA, with 29 KOMCA credits, having contributed to various B-side tracks, including "Wow" in 2020, "Taste" and "Muddy Water" in 2022, and "Red Lights" in 2021. He was also the main songwriter of "DLMLU" from Stray Kids' full-length Japanese album, 'The Sound', and "Cover Me" from their EP 'Rock-Star'!

Hyunjin majored in practical dance at the School of Performing Arts Seoul (SOPA) and on March 25, 2018, he made his debut on the Group's mini album 'I am NOT' through a debut showcase! On May 9, 2028, he blew everyone away with an incredible dance performance he choreographed on "when the party's over" by Billie Eillish, as part of the SKZ_PLAYER series! On December 21, 2020, he released the fan favorite self composed song "miss you" as part of the SKZ-PLAYER series. In October 2021, he was selected as STUDIO CHOOM's "Artist Of The Month", with a special dance performance of "Motley Crew" by Post Malone. On December 21, 2022, Hyunjin participated in writing and composing his original solo song "Love Untold" for the best album SKZ-REPLAY. In 2022 he performed a cover of Kim Sung-jae's "As I Told You" with Felix & Han at the KBS Song Festival and in 2023, he performed a choreographed duet with Itzy's Yeji at the MBC Music Festival, remixing two of their popular individual dance performances! On August 31, 2023, Hyunjin featured on Troye Sivan's amazing remix single "Rush"! He also released "Long For You" on which he sang like an Angel! In December, 2024, Hyunjin released his hot Solo track “So Good" from Stray kIds hugely successful album 'HOP', debuting with 2M streams on Spotify, followed by the single "Quill Pen"! this Friday, March 21, Hyunjin will release his much awaited collab "ESCAPE" with Bang Chan from Stray Kids' highly anticipated digital single 'Mixtape : Dominate'!

Aside from music, Hyunjin is also a TV star, and hosted the weekly chart show, 'Show! Music Core' (2019 - 2021)! He also made his acting debut in the web series A-Teen 2 with a cameo appearance in the final episode, alongside Stray Kids' colleague I.N!

Hyunjin has been cited as an inspiration by multiple artists, including Haru of Nexz and Yujin of Zerobaseone. He has been ranked each year in Tumblr's "K-Pop Stars of the Year", coming in 28th in 2018, 18th in 2019, 19th in 2020, 9th in 2021 and 6th in 2022. He was named "K-Pop's Performance Leader" in an article in October 2021, after his dance performance for Studio Choom's Artist of the Month (October) and in 2024, he was ranked 5th in Billboard's 2024 K-Pop Artist 100! Hyunjin has also been credited with revitalizing the long haired trend for male K-pop idols after going viral for his cover of Red velvet's "Psycho" on KBS' Music Bank! In February 2023, Hyunjin became the youngest artist to be named one of the five top entertainers in Korea on Forbes Korea's "Top 30 under 30". 

Hyunjin is a heartthrob and Fashion Icon, causing a frenzy wherever he goes! On September 5, 2022, he was the Main Event with Felix and Dua Lipa at the YSL Beauty event in Paris. In May 2023, he was a VIP guest  with Troye Sivan at Dua's debut fashion show, "La Vacanza" with Versace during the Cannes Film festival!
In July 2023, he also attended the opening of Versace's "La Vacanza" pop-up store in Seoul. That same month, he became the Global Brand Ambassador for Versace, and on March 13, 2024, Vogue Business ranked him as the celebrity with the highest SNS engagement rate overall, (over 37%) for the 2024 Fall Winter fashion week season during Versace's Fall-Winter 2024 fashion show. In May 2024, he made his Met Gala debut with Stray Kids, becoming the first K-pop group to attend, rocking Tommy Hilfiger custom outfits! In September 2024, Hyunjin became a brand ambassador for Cartier and in February 2025, he was named ambassador for Givenchy Beauty. At christmas, Hyunjin set social media on fire, with a daring buzzcut, becoming the highest trending K-Pop Idol in the US and Worldwide with 2.4 Million Tweets in just 9 Hours after his appearance at the SBS Gayo Daejeon 2024!

Hyunjin is also an active philanthropist, and on February 16, 2023, he donated ₩100 million (US$76,589.47) through the international relief organization, The Promise, to aid relief efforts after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria. As a result, he was appointed a member of the honors club on March 30.
In November 2023, he participated in a fundraising event for the "Love Your W" campaign by W Korea to raise awareness for breast cancer. In 2024, to celebrate his birthday, he donated ₩100 million (US$76,589.47) to the 'Snail of Love', a social welfare organization that provides hearing-impaired people with artificial cochlear surgery and hearing aids, and education to improve public awareness!

Happy 34th birthday to #RedVelvet's very beautiful and hugely talented leader, Main Rapper, lead dancer, vocalist, original Visual Genius, Actress, TV host, Superstar and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One & Only Irene!👏🎂🎉🌟🐐👑❤️
#Irene found fame as the leader of #RedVelvet, one of the best-selling most popular K-Pop groups in the world! She has an incredible voice, and is a very talented dancer with a very charismatic stage presence and has been key to Red Velvet's success around the world! On July 27, 2014, Irene made her official debut as leader of Red Velvet with the hit single "Happiness". Red Velvet has so far released 11 very successful EPs and 2 studio albums as well as two reissue albums!

Irene is also a great TV host and from May 2015 to June 2016, she was the MC of the music show 'Music Bank' with actor #ParkBoGum! Both were named by the Press as one of the best partnerships in the show's history! Irene has also starred as an actress in the web drama 'Women at a Game Company' in 2016  and the sitcom 'Hello! Our Language'! The same year, Irene hosted OnStyle's fashion show 'Laundry Day' and was a panelist on the KBS show 'Trick & True' with #Wendy.  In 2019, Irene released a collab with Korean DJ and producer #Raiden titled "The Only"! 

In 2020, Irene and #Seulgi formed Red Velvet's first sub-unit, Red Velvet - Irene & Seulgi, and debuted on July 6 with the EP 'Monster' which topped the Worldwide iTunes chart and various physical album charts in Korea including Hanteo, Synnara Record and YES24. She and Seulgi also starred in a spin-off version of their reality show 'Level Up Project'! In 2021, Irene starred in her first movie 'Double Patty' and released her own successful OST, titled "A White Night"! 

In 2024 Irene held her first exhibition in Seoul of her photobook titled "1 Page of Irene" and presented her new hit single "I Feel Pretty"! On November 24, 2024, the Suerstar released her debut 8-track EP "Like a Flower" powered by its lead single of the same name! The Album made a spectacular debut selling 250,000 units in South Korea in its first day and reaching #1 on iTunes in 21 countries and also topped the digital album sales chart on China’s QQ Music. On Japan’s AWA real-time trending chart, the tracks from the album ranked 1st to 3rd! The Album hit #1 on the Circle weekly chart in Korea, selling 380,000 copies in its first week!

Irene was named one of the most loved idol celebrities in South Korea by Gallup Korea's Idol Preference poll. In 2019, in a separate survey among soldiers doing mandatory military service in South Korea, Irene was ranked as the 3rd most popular female K-pop idol! She also topped the 'Individual Girl Group Members Brand Power Ranking' numerous times in 2018. Irene is known as a "CF Queen" due to her huge marketing power and has had many endorsement deals ranging from cosmetics, luxury apparel items, and basic commodities. She became a model for Ivy Club with labelmates EXO in 2015. In 2016, she became an endorser of the coffee brand Maxwell House and in 2017, she became the new brand model for Nuovo Shoes. In 2017, Irene became the promotional model for the MMORPG Age of Ring and the official endorser of the  Hyundai Motors Auto Advantage program. In 2019, Irene was named the new muse of the Italian luxury jewelry brand Damiani, the first Asian to represent the brand as a muse. In 2019, she also became the face of Miu Miu, causing a sensation at  their Fashion show during Paris Fashion Week! In 2020, Irene was appointed the new ambassador for Clinique and Prada! 

Irene is also an active philanthropist, and in 2020, she donated ₩100 million for the Community Chest of Korea in aid of those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

Full Text:
Happy 31st Birthday to the gorgeous, extremely talented chart-topping, record-breaking, history-making Rapper, Singer, Songwriter, Top Model, Superstar and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One & Only Jackson Wang! 👏🎂🥳🌟🐐👑❤️‍🔥🎇
#JacksonWang became world famous as the Main Rapper, Lead Dancer and Face genius of the hugely popular chart-topping, record-breaking group #GOT7, one of the best-selling K-Pop Bands of the Era! He has contributed greatly to the Band's success, but he is also a Superstar in his own right and one of the Best Asian Singers and Dancers! He is hugely popular and has the highest number of Instagram followers among Chinese celebrities, with over 33 million! He was also the fastest Chinese Act to reach 10 million views on Vevo! In 2019, he released his self-written and self-produced solo album, 'Mirrors'! The Album peaked at #32 on the Billboard 200, becoming the highest-charting debut album for a Chinese artist in Billboard 200 chart history! On March 20, Wang released his self-written single, "100 Ways" which became the first song by a Chinese and K-pop Solo Artist to debut on Mediabase's U.S. Top 40 radio chart! On September 4, Wang released the EDM hit single "Pretty Please", a collab with Swedish duo Galantis, followed by the Chinese-language hit, "Should've Let Go", with Singaporean Superstar JJ Lin in December 2020. That month, he also appeared at the KBS Song Festival, performing Jessi's "NUNU NANA"! Jackson was ranked 41st on ForbesChina Celebrity 100 list 2020! In March 2021, he featured on "Magnetic" with Rain, "So Bad" with Vava and "M.I.A." with Afgan! On March 26, he dropped his new English single, "LMLY", along with a self-directed 90s Hong Kong movie-inspired MV. The song was included in Teen Vogue's list of the best K-pop songs of 2021! In April 2021, Wang performed "LMLY" at the Harper's Bazaar Fashion Icons Party, where he was named "Musician of the Year." He then made his U.S. late-night TV debut, performing "LMLY" on The Late Late Show With James Corden. By June 2021, he was ranked in the top 10 on ForbesChina Celebrity 100 and was listed on Tatler Hong Kong Asia's Most Influential individuals in the culture field. In July 2021, Jackson became a mentor on the Tencent variety show, 'Girls Like Us' and released a remix of Rich Brian, NIKI, and Warren Hue's "California"! That year, Jackson won several awards, including "Best Male Artist of the Year" at the NetEase Indie Music Awards, "Most Influential Male Singer in Asia" at the Chinese Top Ten Awards and "Best Original Music Award" for the single "Alone" at the Global Chinese Music event! His 2nd album 'Magic Man' (2022) was preceded by the single "BLOW" which he performed at Coachella with "100 Ways". 'Magic Man' hit #15 on the Billboard 200 & #3 on the US Top Album Sales chart! Jackson kicked off his world tour with a sold-out concert in Bangkok on  November, 26, and continued to sell out shows in Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, London and Paris. The tour continued in North America, Mexico and South America. On April 14, 2024, Jackson stole the show at Coachella once again, performing "Feeling lucky" with BIBI as part of 88rising's 'Futures' set. On 26 April, the English single & MV was released by 88rising. 

Jackson was born in Hong Kong to 2 athletic parents. Before joining GOT7, he was a sabre fencing champ, winning multiple awards as part of the Hong Kong national fencing team, and came in first at the Asian Junior and Cadet Fencing Championship in 2011! While preparing for the 2012 London Olympics, he was offered a scholarship to attend Stanford University for fencing, but turned it down after winning his audition with JYP entertainment, and moved to Seoul, South Korea to begin his K-pop training. GOT7 released its first single, "Girls Girls Girls" from its debut EP 'Got It?' on 16 January 2014.

Jackson is also a TV star and has hosted many hugely popular TV programmes! In December 2014, he starred in his first variety show, 'SBS' Roommate', and  was later awarded the Newcomer Award at the 2014 SBS Entertainment Awards. He also appeared on 'Star King', 'Law of the Jungle', 'Happy Together', 'Radio Star', 'Problematic Men', 'Our Neighborhood Arts and Physical Education', 'Saturday Night Live Korea' & 'A Look At Myself' & 'Fresh Sunday'! On 29 April 2016, GOT7 held their first concert in Seoul, with Jackson performing his self-composed songs "I Love It" & "WOLO" with Yugyeom & BamBam. In December 2016, he was named Variety Star of the Year at the Tencent Variety Show Star Awards! In January 2017, Wang was awarded the Popular Artist of the Year award at the Sina Weibo Awards! In December 2017, he was named the Breakthrough Singer of the Year at the Tencent Video Star Awards! Jackson has won numerous other Awards including 8 Weibo Music Awards, 7 Asian Pop Awards, 5 Sine Weibo Night Awards, 5 Net Ease Music Awards, 3 China Top 10 Music Awards, 2 Channel R Radio Awards, 2 Bazaar Icon Awards, 2 Esquire Awards, 2 C-Pop Hot Show Awards, 2 Global 1 Wave Music Awards, a Teen Choice Award, an SBS Entertainment Award, 3 Ten Cent Video All Star Night Awards, a Top Chinese Music Award, a Global Chinese Golden Chart Award, a Universe Boom Super Sphere award, a Philippine K-Pop Award and an Asia Music Gala Award! 

Jackson is also a successful entrepreneur, and in 2017, he founded 'Team Wang', and became the creative director and lead designer for its subsidiary fashion brand Team Wang Design! He is a Top Model, a Fashion Icon and Global Ambassador for Cartier!

Jackson is also a Philanthropist, and in January 2025, he donated ¥1 million yuan to the China Foundation for Rural Development to help those affected by the Tibet earthquake!

[Article] #JUNGKOOK #JHOPE #RM to #BTS , 'The best K-pop/rap collaboration of all time' 5 songs uploaded✨

The various collaborations of the group BTS have received favorable reviews from foreign media.

On the 28th (local time), the American media outlet Complex announced the '15 Best K-Pop and Rap Collaborations of All Time'. It selected excellent works among the collaborations between Korean singers and famous foreign rappers, and five songs by BTS were on the list.

Jungkook solo single 'Seven (feat. Latto)', J-Hope solo single 'on the street (with J. Happy 25th Birthday to the gorgeous, hugely talented Rapper, Singer, Song-writer, Dancer, Actor, TV host, Top Model, Superstar and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One and Only #Hyunjin!👏🎂🎉🌟🐐👑🤍
#Hyunjin found fame as the main dancer, rapper, vocalist and visual genius of the chart-topping, record-breaking, history-making Iconic Band #StrayKids, the Biggest selling K-Pop Act currently in the US! He is one of the World's Best Dancers and has the most amazing voice and has contributed greatly to Stray Kids global success both as a performer and lyricist! He is the 4th most accredited song-writer of the group, after Stray Kids' production team, 3RACHA, with 29 KOMCA credits, having contributed to various B-side tracks, including "Wow" in 2020, "Taste" and "Muddy Water" in 2022, and "Red Lights" in 2021. He was also the main songwriter of "DLMLU" from Stray Kids' full-length Japanese album, 'The Sound', and "Cover Me" from their EP 'Rock-Star'!

Hyunjin majored in practical dance at the School of Performing Arts Seoul (SOPA) and on March 25, 2018, he made his debut on the Group's mini album 'I am NOT' through a debut showcase! On May 9, 2028, he blew everyone away with an incredible dance performance he choreographed on "when the party's over" by Billie Eillish, as part of the SKZ_PLAYER series! On December 21, 2020, he released the fan favorite self composed song "miss you" as part of the SKZ-PLAYER series. In October 2021, he was selected as STUDIO CHOOM's "Artist Of The Month", with a special dance performance of "Motley Crew" by Post Malone. On December 21, 2022, Hyunjin participated in writing and composing his original solo song "Love Untold" for the best album SKZ-REPLAY. In 2022 he performed a cover of Kim Sung-jae's "As I Told You" with Felix & Han at the KBS Song Festival and in 2023, he performed a choreographed duet with Itzy's Yeji at the MBC Music Festival, remixing two of their popular individual dance performances! On August 31, 2023, Hyunjin featured on Troye Sivan's amazing remix single "Rush"! He also released "Long For You" on which he sang like an Angel! In December, 2024, Hyunjin released his hot Solo track “So Good" from Stray kIds hugely successful album 'HOP', debuting with 2M streams on Spotify, followed by the single "Quill Pen"! this Friday, March 21, Hyunjin will release his much awaited collab "ESCAPE" with Bang Chan from Stray Kids' highly anticipated digital single 'Mixtape : Dominate'!

Aside from music, Hyunjin is also a TV star, and hosted the weekly chart show, 'Show! Music Core' (2019 - 2021)! He also made his acting debut in the web series A-Teen 2 with a cameo appearance in the final episode, alongside Stray Kids' colleague I.N!

Hyunjin has been cited as an inspiration by multiple artists, including Haru of Nexz and Yujin of Zerobaseone. He has been ranked each year in Tumblr's "K-Pop Stars of the Year", coming in 28th in 2018, 18th in 2019, 19th in 2020, 9th in 2021 and 6th in 2022. He was named "K-Pop's Performance Leader" in an article in October 2021, after his dance performance for Studio Choom's Artist of the Month (October) and in 2024, he was ranked 5th in Billboard's 2024 K-Pop Artist 100! Hyunjin has also been credited with revitalizing the long haired trend for male K-pop idols after going viral for his cover of Red velvet's "Psycho" on KBS' Music Bank! In February 2023, Hyunjin became the youngest artist to be named one of the five top entertainers in Korea on Forbes Korea's "Top 30 under 30". 

Hyunjin is a heartthrob and Fashion Icon, causing a frenzy wherever he goes! On September 5, 2022, he was the Main Event with Felix and Dua Lipa at the YSL Beauty event in Paris. In May 2023, he was a VIP guest  with Troye Sivan at Dua's debut fashion show, "La Vacanza" with Versace during the Cannes Film festival!
In July 2023, he also attended the opening of Versace's "La Vacanza" pop-up store in Seoul. That same month, he became the Global Brand Ambassador for Versace, and on March 13, 2024, Vogue Business ranked him as the celebrity with the highest SNS engagement rate overall, (over 37%) for the 2024 Fall Winter fashion week season during Versace's Fall-Winter 2024 fashion show. In May 2024, he made his Met Gala debut with Stray Kids, becoming the first K-pop group to attend, rocking Tommy Hilfiger custom outfits! In September 2024, Hyunjin became a brand ambassador for Cartier and in February 2025, he was named ambassador for Givenchy Beauty. At christmas, Hyunjin set social media on fire, with a daring buzzcut, becoming the highest trending K-Pop Idol in the US and Worldwide with 2.4 Million Tweets in just 9 Hours after his appearance at the SBS Gayo Daejeon 2024!

Hyunjin is also an active philanthropist, and on February 16, 2023, he donated ₩100 million (US$76,589.47) through the international relief organization, The Promise, to aid relief efforts after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria. As a result, he was appointed a member of the honors club on March 30.
In November 2023, he participated in a fundraising event for the "Love Your W" campaign by W Korea to raise awareness for breast cancer. In 2024, to celebrate his birthday, he donated ₩100 million (US$76,589.47) to the 'Snail of Love', a social welfare organization that provides hearing-impaired people with artificial cochlear surgery and hearing aids, and education to improve public awareness!

YUNHO became famous as the Main Dancer and Vocalist of the hugely popular, chart-topping, record-breaking, top-selling K-pop Superstar Group, ATEEZ! He is a professional trained dancer, and is admired for his sizzling dance moves, his charismatic stage presence and his perfect technique! He is also an amazing singer and great song-writer and co-penned ATEEZ's platinum certified chart-topping album 'The World EP.Fin: Will'! 

YUNHO graduated from SOPA and was the second member to join KQ Entertainment. He is the energizer of the group for his powerful presence onstage and off, and his code name is ATEEZ Ep.1! YUNHO is also famous for starring in K-Dramas and hosting important programs on Korean national television! He is a Global Performance Idol and has won several awards as part of the group including the Worldwide Fans' Choice Award at the 2019, 2020, and 2023 Mnet Asian Music Awards and the Bonsang award (main prize) at the 4th Fact Music Awards and the 30th and 31st Seoul Music Awards. He also won with the other group members the Grand Honor's Choice award (daesang) at the 2024 Korea Grand Music Awards. 

In 2024, ATEEZ became the first K-pop boy group to perform at Coachella and YUNHO was the highest trending group member on X the first weekend for his spectacular dance moves! ATEEZ were also the first K-pop group to headline the Mawazine music festival in Morocco where YUNHO also slayed. On May 25, 2024, YUNHO caused a sensation, throwing the first pitch for the Kia Tigers in a match against the Doosan Bears in Gwangju. On August 1, 2024, he starred in the music video for the song "Kung Kung Dda" by Seo Eve.

As a member of ATEEZ, YUNHO has been endorsed by several global brands. On July 1, 2021 YUNHO took part in the 2021 Pepsi Taste of Korea Campaign, with Hongjoong, Rain, Brave Girls and Monsta X for the song "Summer Taste", which was released on July 14.
In February, 2022, he collaborated with online fashion store Poshmark, and on July 14, 2022 he was announced as an advertising model for Korean cosmetics brand Mernel. In January, 2024, he was selected by the cosmetics brand Nacific as its brand model. In March, 2024, YUNHO with Ateez became the exclusive model for Cafe BomBom. On March 22, 2024, ATEEZ was selected as an advertising model for the Japanese pharmaceutical brand Rohto UV. On April 23, ATEEZ collaborated with ABC-Mart for Adidas' "CLIMACOOL" series campaign! YUNHO has served as an official global ambassador for Korean culture and tourism.

As a member of ATEEZ, YUNHO is very much into charity and helping others. In September, 2020, he became an ambassador for Polished Man, an initiative raising funds for trauma prevention and recovery programs for young survivors of violence. In May, 2021, ATEEZ raised over $20,000 towards Pacific Bridge Arts Musical Scholarships and the Gold House AAPI Community Fund. In November 2022, in the wake of the Seoul Halloween crowd crush, ATEEZ donated ₩100 million to the Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief Association, from proceeds from their concerts.

Full Text:
Happy Birthday to ASTRO's gorgeous, extremely talented, chart-topping, award-winning singer, songwriter, actor, TV star, top model and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One & Only Cha Eun Woo!💪🎂🥳🌟👑💜🎇
#ChaEunWoo became famous as the vocalist, Visual & Face Genius of the hugely popular, chart-topping K-Pop Group #ASTRO, and has been key to the group's global success, but he became an even bigger Superstar in his own right! He’s not only one of the best-looking guys in the world, but has also an amazing voice and is an incredible performer and all round entertainer! Cha has released several hit singles as a lead artist, including "Don't Cry, My Love", a ballad for the official soundtrack of the comic 'Under The Oak Tree' and a remake of "Jealousy" on October 18, 2023, for the official soundtrack of the drama 'A Good Day to Be a Dog'. On October 27, 2023, he became the first artist to receive the Global Icon Award at the MTV Video Music Awards in Japan, a special award created to honor the achievements of global activities as an artist! On February 15, 2024 Cha made a victorious debut with his 1st EP 'ENTITY', soaring to #1 on the Worldwide & European iTunes album charts after going to #1 on iTunes in over 20 countries! The album featured his emotional self-written lead single "STAY", which also went to #1 on iTunes in several countries! 'ENTITY' debuted at #2 on the Circle Album chart in Korea and #15 on the Oricon Album chart in Japan!  

Cha is also a very talented actor and made his acting debut in the film My Brilliant Life (2014). He became extremely popular in 2018, after starring in the JTBC romantic comedy series 'Gangnam Beauty', his first leading role on TV! After the series aired, he was included on GQ Korea's "Men of the Year" list! In 2019, Cha starred in the historical drama 'Rookie Historian Goo Hae-ryung' alongside Shin Se-kyung. In 2020, he won the Rookie Award at the 2020 SBS Entertainment Awards, for his role on the TV show 'Master in the House'! Cha reached new popularity heights after his role in MBC's new mystery drama "Wonderful World"! 

Due to his charisma, massive popularity and huge marketing power, Cha is one of the K-Pop Artists with the most endorsement deals! In 2021, he became Penshoppe's international ambassador, the brand model for Noona Holdak Chicken, the new model for clothing brand O'Neill, the brand ambassador for Burberry, Konvy's first presenter & the new muse of Dashu Perfume! In 2022, he became the muse for the hair styling brand Dashu, the brand ambassador for Ms Glow & Mister Potato, a model for Liberclassy, and the brand ambassador for Dior Beauty and Dior! In 2023, Cha became a brand ambassador for Skechers, a muse for Chaumet, a brand ambassador for Est Cola and was appointed the honorary ambassador for the '2023–2024 Visit Korea Year', participating in its launch ceremony with First Lady Kim Keon-hee! In 2024, Cha became a brand model for Subway and the Global Brand ambassador for Dior & Dior Beauty! In September 2024, he became the new face of Calvin Klein's Fall 2024 menswear collections, including the Calvin Klein Studio line! Cha became the global ambassador for the French luxury jewellery and watch house Chaumet in 2024, and was chosen as an ambassador for the French luxury fashion house Saint Laurent. In October 2024, he became the brand ambassador for Calvin Klein. In March 2025, Cha became a brand ambassador for international clothing brand Marithé et François Girbaud. Cha is a Fashion Icon and is the Main Event wherever he goes, causing a frenzy, especially when he attends Paris Fashion week! 

Cha has won numerous accolades. In 2018, he won the Asia Artist Award for Rising Star and was named one of GQ Korea's Men of the Year, and in 2019, he won the Soompi Award for Breakout Actor and was named the male "Hot Instagrammer"!  In 2021, he won the Asia Artist Award for Emotive actor and was 17th on Forbes Korea Power Celebrity list! In 2023, Cha was on Forbes 30 Under 30 and ranked 11th on Gallup Korea's Television Actor of the Year list! He was honoured with the Global Icon Award at the 2023 MTV Video Music Awards in Japan, the Star of the year Award at the Hallyu Talk Awards (2023), the Best Male Idol-actor Award at the Korea First Brand Awards and the Best New Actor & Popularity Star Awards at the Blue Dragon Series Awards! In 2024, he won Best Male Idol and Actor at the Korea First brand awards,  Hot Trend Male Actor at the Brand Customer Loyalty Awards and was named Best Actor by the Blue Dragon Ranking. That same year he was recognized as one of the 2024 top male influencers in Lefty's "A Year in Data" report, achieving an Earned Media Value (EMV) of $98.9 million. At Paris Fashion Week AW Womenswear 2025, he represented Saint Laurent and ranked #4 with an EMV of $17 million. He was also #1 on the Korea Brand Reputation Indices January-February, and #2 in March! Cha also received the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Commendation of the 2024 Korea Popular Culture and Arts Awards.  He has been recognized in Madame Tussauds' "HOT 100" list in 2025.  

Cha is also an active philanthropist and donated ₩10 million to help support the victims of the Sokcho Fire, and ₩30 million to help those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea. In November 2022, Cha held a photo exhibition and donated all profits to the underprivileged. In 2023, Cha donated ₩10 million for the Ice Bucket Challenge campaign! In October 2024, he took part in the "Love Your W" breast cancer awareness campaign and W Korea's charity event. He donated his own personal items to "WeAJa Sharing Market 2024", South Korea's largest charity event, with all proceeds going to support underprivileged children and vulnerable groups affected by the climate crisis.
Cha just recently donated ₩100 million to the Korean Red Cross after Korea's largest wildfire to support victims with relief vehicles, emergency aid kits, shelters, and blankets.

Full Text:
Happy Birthday to ASTRO's gorgeous, extremely talented, chart-topping, award-winning singer, songwriter, actor, TV star, top model and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One & Only Cha Eun Woo!💪🎂🥳🌟👑💜🎇
#ChaEunWoo became famous as the vocalist, Visual & Face Genius of the hugely popular, chart-topping K-Pop Group #ASTRO, and has been key to the group's global success, but he became an even bigger Superstar in his own right! He’s not only one of the best-looking guys in the world, but has also an amazing voice and is an incredible performer and all round entertainer! Cha has released several hit singles as a lead artist, including "Don't Cry, My Love", a ballad for the official soundtrack of the comic 'Under The Oak Tree' and a remake of "Jealousy" on October 18, 2023, for the official soundtrack of the drama 'A Good Day to Be a Dog'. On October 27, 2023, he became the first artist to receive the Global Icon Award at the MTV Video Music Awards in Japan, a special award created to honor the achievements of global activities as an artist! On February 15, 2024 Cha made a victorious debut with his 1st EP 'ENTITY', soaring to #1 on the Worldwide & European iTunes album charts after going to #1 on iTunes in over 20 countries! The album featured his emotional self-written lead single "STAY", which also went to #1 on iTunes in several countries! 'ENTITY' debuted at #2 on the Circle Album chart in Korea and #15 on the Oricon Album chart in Japan!  

Cha is also a very talented actor and made his acting debut in the film My Brilliant Life (2014). He became extremely popular in 2018, after starring in the JTBC romantic comedy series 'Gangnam Beauty', his first leading role on TV! After the series aired, he was included on GQ Korea's "Men of the Year" list! In 2019, Cha starred in the historical drama 'Rookie Historian Goo Hae-ryung' alongside Shin Se-kyung. In 2020, he won the Rookie Award at the 2020 SBS Entertainment Awards, for his role on the TV show 'Master in the House'! Cha reached new popularity heights after his role in MBC's new mystery drama "Wonderful World"! 

Due to his charisma, massive popularity and huge marketing power, Cha is one of the K-Pop Artists with the most endorsement deals! In 2021, he became Penshoppe's international ambassador, the brand model for Noona Holdak Chicken, the new model for clothing brand O'Neill, the brand ambassador for Burberry, Konvy's first presenter & the new muse of Dashu Perfume! In 2022, he became the muse for the hair styling brand Dashu, the brand ambassador for Ms Glow & Mister Potato, a model for Liberclassy, and the brand ambassador for Dior Beauty and Dior! In 2023, Cha became a brand ambassador for Skechers, a muse for Chaumet, a brand ambassador for Est Cola and was appointed the honorary ambassador for the '2023–2024 Visit Korea Year', participating in its launch ceremony with First Lady Kim Keon-hee! In 2024, Cha became a brand model for Subway and the Global Brand ambassador for Dior & Dior Beauty! In September 2024, he became the new face of Calvin Klein's Fall 2024 menswear collections, including the Calvin Klein Studio line! Cha became the global ambassador for the French luxury jewellery and watch house Chaumet in 2024, and was chosen as an ambassador for the French luxury fashion house Saint Laurent. In October 2024, he became the brand ambassador for Calvin Klein. In March 2025, Cha became a brand ambassador for international clothing brand Marithé et François Girbaud. Cha is a Fashion Icon and is the Main Event wherever he goes, causing a frenzy, especially when he attends Paris Fashion week! 

Cha has won numerous accolades. In 2018, he won the Asia Artist Award for Rising Star and was named one of GQ Korea's Men of the Year, and in 2019, he won the Soompi Award for Breakout Actor and was named the male "Hot Instagrammer"!  In 2021, he won the Asia Artist Award for Emotive actor and was 17th on Forbes Korea Power Celebrity list! In 2023, Cha was on Forbes 30 Under 30 and ranked 11th on Gallup Korea's Television Actor of the Year list! He was honoured with the Global Icon Award at the 2023 MTV Video Music Awards in Japan, the Star of the year Award at the Hallyu Talk Awards (2023), the Best Male Idol-actor Award at the Korea First Brand Awards and the Best New Actor & Popularity Star Awards at the Blue Dragon Series Awards! In 2024, he won Best Male Idol and Actor at the Korea First brand awards,  Hot Trend Male Actor at the Brand Customer Loyalty Awards and was named Best Actor by the Blue Dragon Ranking. That same year he was recognized as one of the 2024 top male influencers in Lefty's "A Year in Data" report, achieving an Earned Media Value (EMV) of $98.9 million. At Paris Fashion Week AW Womenswear 2025, he represented Saint Laurent and ranked #4 with an EMV of $17 million. He was also #1 on the Korea Brand Reputation Indices January-February, and #2 in March! Cha also received the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Commendation of the 2024 Korea Popular Culture and Arts Awards.  He has been recognized in Madame Tussauds' "HOT 100" list in 2025.  

Cha is also an active philanthropist and donated ₩10 million to help support the victims of the Sokcho Fire, and ₩30 million to help those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea. In November 2022, Cha held a photo exhibition and donated all profits to the underprivileged. In 2023, Cha donated ₩10 million for the Ice Bucket Challenge campaign! In October 2024, he took part in the "Love Your W" breast cancer awareness campaign and W Korea's charity event. He donated his own personal items to "WeAJa Sharing Market 2024", South Korea's largest charity event, with all proceeds going to support underprivileged children and vulnerable groups affected by the climate crisis.
Cha just recently donated ₩100 million to the Korean Red Cross after Korea's largest wildfire to support victims with relief vehicles, emergency aid kits, shelters, and blankets.

Full Text:
Happy Birthday to ASTRO's gorgeous, extremely talented, chart-topping, award-winning singer, songwriter, actor, TV star, top model and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One & Only Cha Eun Woo!💪🎂🥳🌟👑💜🎇
#ChaEunWoo became famous as the vocalist, Visual & Face Genius of the hugely popular, chart-topping K-Pop Group #ASTRO, and has been key to the group's global success, but he became an even bigger Superstar in his own right! He’s not only one of the best-looking guys in the world, but has also an amazing voice and is an incredible performer and all round entertainer! Cha has released several hit singles as a lead artist, including "Don't Cry, My Love", a ballad for the official soundtrack of the comic 'Under The Oak Tree' and a remake of "Jealousy" on October 18, 2023, for the official soundtrack of the drama 'A Good Day to Be a Dog'. On October 27, 2023, he became the first artist to receive the Global Icon Award at the MTV Video Music Awards in Japan, a special award created to honor the achievements of global activities as an artist! On February 15, 2024 Cha made a victorious debut with his 1st EP 'ENTITY', soaring to #1 on the Worldwide & European iTunes album charts after going to #1 on iTunes in over 20 countries! The album featured his emotional self-written lead single "STAY", which also went to #1 on iTunes in several countries! 'ENTITY' debuted at #2 on the Circle Album chart in Korea and #15 on the Oricon Album chart in Japan!  

Cha is also a very talented actor and made his acting debut in the film My Brilliant Life (2014). He became extremely popular in 2018, after starring in the JTBC romantic comedy series 'Gangnam Beauty', his first leading role on TV! After the series aired, he was included on GQ Korea's "Men of the Year" list! In 2019, Cha starred in the historical drama 'Rookie Historian Goo Hae-ryung' alongside Shin Se-kyung. In 2020, he won the Rookie Award at the 2020 SBS Entertainment Awards, for his role on the TV show 'Master in the House'! Cha reached new popularity heights after his role in MBC's new mystery drama "Wonderful World"! 

Due to his charisma, massive popularity and huge marketing power, Cha is one of the K-Pop Artists with the most endorsement deals! In 2021, he became Penshoppe's international ambassador, the brand model for Noona Holdak Chicken, the new model for clothing brand O'Neill, the brand ambassador for Burberry, Konvy's first presenter & the new muse of Dashu Perfume! In 2022, he became the muse for the hair styling brand Dashu, the brand ambassador for Ms Glow & Mister Potato, a model for Liberclassy, and the brand ambassador for Dior Beauty and Dior! In 2023, Cha became a brand ambassador for Skechers, a muse for Chaumet, a brand ambassador for Est Cola and was appointed the honorary ambassador for the '2023–2024 Visit Korea Year', participating in its launch ceremony with First Lady Kim Keon-hee! In 2024, Cha became a brand model for Subway and the Global Brand ambassador for Dior & Dior Beauty! In September 2024, he became the new face of Calvin Klein's Fall 2024 menswear collections, including the Calvin Klein Studio line! Cha became the global ambassador for the French luxury jewellery and watch house Chaumet in 2024, and was chosen as an ambassador for the French luxury fashion house Saint Laurent. In October 2024, he became the brand ambassador for Calvin Klein. In March 2025, Cha became a brand ambassador for international clothing brand Marithé et François Girbaud. Cha is a Fashion Icon and is the Main Event wherever he goes, causing a frenzy, especially when he attends Paris Fashion week! 

Cha has won numerous accolades. In 2018, he won the Asia Artist Award for Rising Star and was named one of GQ Korea's Men of the Year, and in 2019, he won the Soompi Award for Breakout Actor and was named the male "Hot Instagrammer"!  In 2021, he won the Asia Artist Award for Emotive actor and was 17th on Forbes Korea Power Celebrity list! In 2023, Cha was on Forbes 30 Under 30 and ranked 11th on Gallup Korea's Television Actor of the Year list! He was honoured with the Global Icon Award at the 2023 MTV Video Music Awards in Japan, the Star of the year Award at the Hallyu Talk Awards (2023), the Best Male Idol-actor Award at the Korea First Brand Awards and the Best New Actor & Popularity Star Awards at the Blue Dragon Series Awards! In 2024, he won Best Male Idol and Actor at the Korea First brand awards,  Hot Trend Male Actor at the Brand Customer Loyalty Awards and was named Best Actor by the Blue Dragon Ranking. That same year he was recognized as one of the 2024 top male influencers in Lefty's "A Year in Data" report, achieving an Earned Media Value (EMV) of $98.9 million. At Paris Fashion Week AW Womenswear 2025, he represented Saint Laurent and ranked #4 with an EMV of $17 million. He was also #1 on the Korea Brand Reputation Indices January-February, and #2 in March! Cha also received the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Commendation of the 2024 Korea Popular Culture and Arts Awards.  He has been recognized in Madame Tussauds' "HOT 100" list in 2025.  

Cha is also an active philanthropist and donated ₩10 million to help support the victims of the Sokcho Fire, and ₩30 million to help those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea. In November 2022, Cha held a photo exhibition and donated all profits to the underprivileged. In 2023, Cha donated ₩10 million for the Ice Bucket Challenge campaign! In October 2024, he took part in the "Love Your W" breast cancer awareness campaign and W Korea's charity event. He donated his own personal items to "WeAJa Sharing Market 2024", South Korea's largest charity event, with all proceeds going to support underprivileged children and vulnerable groups affected by the climate crisis.
Cha just recently donated ₩100 million to the Korean Red Cross after Korea's largest wildfire to support victims with relief vehicles, emergency aid kits, shelters, and blankets.

#ROSÉ & #BrunoMars' "APT.3 rebounds 4-3 on Global Spotify with 5.209 Million streams, the longest-charting song by a K-Pop Act in the Top 5 in Global Spotify history, and is BACK #1 on the Worldwide iTunes Song chart for a 124th day, extending its record as the longest-running #1 song of the decade and the 3rd longest-running #1 song in Worldwide iTunes history! 💪🏢3⃣🔙🌎🎧➕1⃣🔙🌎🎵✖️1⃣2⃣4⃣🕛➕🏆🥇📈1⃣🎶2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣0️⃣s ➕🏆🥉📈1⃣🎶🐐🐐➕👑👑❤️‍🔥
Longest running songs at #1 in Worldwide iTunes History:
1⃣Happy - Pharrell Williams (188 days) 
2⃣Shallow - LadyGaga & Bradley Cooper (154 days) 
3⃣APT. - ROSÉ & Bruno Mars (124 days) 
4⃣Flowers - MileyCyrus (119 days) 

"APT." rebounds 5-3 on European iTunes after 86 days at #1, holds at #2 on the Worldwide Apple Music song chart after 63 days at #1 and rebounds to #3 (+1) on European Apple Music after 51 days at #1!

"APT." lifts 14-13 on US iTunes after peaking at #1 and shoots 64-54 on US Apple Music after peaking at #18! It's the 3rd highest-charting song by a K-Pop Act in US Apple Music history! "APT" has reached #1 on iTunes in 93 countries, the Most for a song by a Female Act released in 2024, and has hit #1 on Apple Music in 62 countries, the 1st and Only Song by a K-pop Artist in history to reach this Milestone! 

ROSÉ is #10 on the Global Digital Rank with 2279 points currently and Bruno is #9 with 2347 points! Rosé has currently over 52,525M monthly listeners and is #41 in the world. Bruno has currently over 134,043M and is still #1 in the World!

"APT." is the 2nd Most watched MV on YouTube Worldwide over the past 24 hours with over 5.865M views! It has now over 1,467 BILLION views after breaking the record for the fastest MV by an Asian Act to reach 1.4 Billion views in YouTube history (164 days), surpassing PSY’s “Gangnam Style” (233 days)! It's the Fastest MV of the Decade and the 5th fastest MV in history to reach 1.4B!  

Fastest MV's by K-pop Acts to reach 1.4 Billion views in YouTube history:  
#1. APT. — 164 days 🆕
#2. Gangnam Style — 233 days
#3. Dynamite — 552 days 
#4. DDU-DU DDU-DU — 891 days 
#5. Kill This Love — 904 days 

Fastest MVs to reach 1.4B views in history:
#1. Despacito - Luis Fonsi ft. Daddy Yankee  — 121.2 days
#2. Shape Of You  - Ed Sheeran  — 130.9 days
#3. Hello  - Adele  — 160.6 days
#4. Mi Gente  - J Balvin & Willy William  — 160.6 days
#5. APT. - Rosé & Bruno Mars — 164 days

"APT." was also the Fastest Asian MV to hit 1 BILLION views in YouTube history in just 105 days, surpassing PSY’s “Gangnam Style” (158 days) and the 5th overall fastest video of All Time to it 1B! 

“APT.” (24 weeks) is now the 3rd longest-charting video by a K-pop soloist on the YouTube Global Weekly Top Music Videos chart!

“APT.” is the 3rd most liked video by a K-pop soloist in YouTube history! It surpassed 15M likes in just 162 days and is the 1st MV of 2024 to reach this Milestone! 
WATCH: https://t.co/AH9JlB1VQa……… 

“APT.” is the most viewed video of 2025 and 2024 on YouTube!  2024 was the first year in YouTube history, a female/male duet, "APT", was the most viewed MV! ROSÉ joined PSY as the only K-pop Acts to have the most viewed music video of the year in YouTube history with “Gangnam Style” in 2012 and “APT.” in 2024! 

"APT." has now over 1,491B streams after reaching 1.4B in just 159 days! "APT."  is the 2nd Fastest song in Spotify history after "Die With A Smile" to hit 1.4B and the fastest song by a K-pop act in history to reach the milestone! 

Fastest songs to 1.4 Billion streams in Spotify history 
1⃣ “Die With A Smile” — 138 Days
2⃣“APT.” — 159 🆕 
3⃣“BIRDS OF A FEATHER” — 172 
4⃣ “Espresso” — 179 
5⃣ “Who” — 191  

“APT.” is #2 on this week’s Billboard Global 200 and Excl. US charts. "APT." has spent 12 weeks atop the Billboard Global 200, the longest-running #1 song of 2024 & the 4th longest-running No. 1 hit in the chart's history. It has also spent a record-breaking 19 non-consecutive weeks atop the Global Excl. US, surpassing Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You" as the longest-running #1 hit in Billboard Global Excl. US history!

"APT." rebounds 10-7 on this week's US hot 100, and extends its record as the longest-running Top 10 song by a K-Pop soloist in history! It's the 2nd longest-running top 10 song by a K-pop act in Hot 100 history (14 weeks)!

"APT." scores a 7th week atop the Canadian Hot 100, becoming the longest-running #1 song of 2025! 

"APT." is #17 on this week's official UK chart after peaking at #2! It's the longest-charting song by a K-pop female act in UK Official chart history (25 weeks) and the longest-running UK top 5 hit by a K-pop Act in history! “APT.” is the first song by a K-pop Female Act to top the chart in UK Official chart history!

"APT." holds at #2 this week on the ARIA chart in Australia after debuting atop the chart and ruling for 11 non-consecutive weeks! It's the longest-running No. 1 song released in 2024, the longest-running #1 duet since Elton John and Dua Lipa's "Cold Heart (Pnau remix)" in 2021 and the first song by a K-pop female soloist to top the ARIA Singles Chart in history!  

"APT." is #5 in New Zealand this week! The song debuted atop the New Zealand Singles Chart, becoming Rosé's 1st chart-topper in her country of birth, and Bruno's 6th! It's the longest-running No. 1 song released in 2024 and Rosé's first No. 1 and Bruno's 6th No. 1 song!

Hosted in collaboration with Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity Inc, this annual tradition calls upon community members to donate a new pair of denim (or more) for Houston-area youth presently in foster care. This year, one of my favorite highlights was being able to hear from one of the founding leaders of this event speak on how it came to be following many years of service she committed to Child Protective Services and seeing the need to bring about positive change. 

May this project continue to bless our local children in need and continue inspiring others to give their best in service of others.

[💌] Best boy Cha Eunwoo...

“According to entertainment industry sources on the 20th, #CHAEUNWOO recently gifted bracelets from the luxury brand Chaumet, for which he serves as a brand ambassador, to the artists who participated in the digital single  ‘꿈속의 문’(Moon).

A total of 22 artists participated, including ASTRO members, Moonbin’s sister Moon Sua of Billlie, VIVIZ, Minhyuk, Kihyun, and I.M of MONSTA X, Hoshi, Wonwoo, Mingyu, Dokyeom, and Seungkwan of SEVENTEEN, HELLO GLOOM, Rocky, Choi Yoojung, Kim Doyeon, Chani of SF9, and Bang Chan of Stray Kids. It is said that Cha Eunwoo prepared these gifts to express his gratitude to the fellow artists who came together to honor Moonbin and to share cherished memories of the late singer.

Meanwhile, all proceeds from the song  ‘꿈속의 문’(Moon) will be donated to those in need.”

BTS V’s song “Winter Ahead” (with Park Hyo Shin) continues to dominate global music charts, surpassing 270 million streams on Spotify. The track has charted for 143 days on Spotify Global and 100 days on Apple Music’s Worldwide Song Chart.

Released on November 29, 2023, the song made impressive debuts:
•#99 on the US Billboard Hot 100
•#1 on Billboard’s Holiday Digital Song Sales
•#62 on Holiday Top 100
•#86 on the UK Official Singles Chart
•#1 on UK’s Singles Download Chart
•#2 on UK’s Singles Sales Chart

V is the only K-pop artist with three songs on the Billboard Holiday Hot 100 (Christmas Tree, White Christmas, and Winter Ahead) and the only one to achieve #1 on Holiday Digital Song Sales with all three.

The music video also topped TIDAL’s Global Top Video Chart for the longest period ever by a K-pop artist, ranking #1 in countries like the US, UK, Brazil, Spain, Australia, and Singapore.

Winter Ahead was named one of Billboard’s “27 Best Winter Songs” and selected as the #1 fan-favorite song of 2024, further proving its lasting impact and V’s unmatched popularity.

Text: It’s disheartening to see people you once respected reveal their true colors, hiding hypocrisy beneath a polished exterior for years. It’s painful to realize that people whom you thought had integrity can turn a blind eye to something so obvious because of personal benefits. But
Full Text:
It’s disheartening to see people you once respected reveal their true colors, hiding hypocrisy beneath a polished exterior for years. It’s painful to realize that people whom you thought had integrity can turn a blind eye to something so obvious because of personal benefits. But I get it—sometimes you have to play along to survive. So by all means do what you must my brother.

Let’s address the elephant in the room. First of all, I find it amusing how quickly some of you have distanced yourselves from adding the Speaker to the list of El-Rufai’s “loyalists” rewarded by Tinubu. Just few months ago, everyone of you guys was sharing that screenshot claiming Tinubu backed the Speaker to compensate El-Rufai. Now, after recent events, that narrative has quietly disappeared. Convenient, isn’t it? 😂

El-Rufai was betrayed by Tinubu—let’s call it what it is. Stop pretending otherwise. How does El-Rufai fail a ministerial screening for “insecurity in his state” when that same insecurity predated his tenure by decades? Meanwhile, Bello Matawalle, with a similar record, sails through? 

For the sake of this conversation let’s accept that El-Rufai was blocked by others and not Tinubu himself, what about the person he nominated as a replacement? Was that nominee also a security risk? Jafaru was rejected and then detained for over a month during Ramadan, and his only “crime” was that recommendation and being loyal to El-Rufai.

Secondly, many of the names mentioned as El-Rufai’s “loyalists” are indeed his associates, they are brilliant, qualified individuals who has the capacity to do well in their various assigned roles. But none of them got their positions because of El-Rufai’s recommendation. In fact their biggest qualifications for those appointments was having a crack with El-Rufai. Hadiza Bala Usman  parted ways with El-Rufai since her issues with CRA, because she believes he didn’t support her enough during her NPA crisis, which cost her the job. (This is someone El-Rufai practically mentored, and made.) I don’t even want to talk about Dattijo, As for Hannatu Musawa, I’m still puzzled how she’s suddenly El-Rufai’s “protégé.” Are we just adding names to fit an agenda? 😂

The hypocrisy peaks when you label El-Rufai “impatient.” Were we not all here when he stayed silent until when Escobar and Johnny Sins started targeted his loyalists with baseless accusations and imprisonments? 

The man remained quiet when the EFCC and ICPC rummaged through every office he’d ever worked in, including El-Rufai and Partners, a firm he founded in his 20s. When they found nothing, they went after his wives’ former workplaces. Still nothing. So they resorted to fabricating allegations to arrest his closest allies, like Bashir Saidu and Jimi Lawal. In Jafaru Sani’s case, they didn’t even bother cooking up a proper charge. 

Yet El-Rufai is “impatient” for finally pushing back? For refusing to sit idly as knives are plunged into his back? That’s rich.

El-Rufai was betrayed, not just by Tinubu but by his former supporters and admirers who stayed silent as the government came for him with everything they had and to my greatest surprise those acclaimed supporters expected him to take it lying down. 

The audacity.

Full Text:
So... I went to Red Velvet Irene & Seulgi <Balance> concert yesterday. It truly felt like a gift because the concert actually happened right after such a torturing finals week for me 😭💕

Idk if it's because I began liking Red Velvet as Soshi's dongsaeng group, but yesterday's concert somehow made me feel like a super proud unnie watching their growth as performers (I'm actually younger than both of Aseul, though HAHA)

I thoroughly enjoyed the show and found it super entertaining overall. Both Irene and Seulgi were ON FIRE and did fantastic yesterday but I'm not gonna lie, it was probably my very first time in a while seeing Irene being this carefree and confident on stage. 

Bae Joohyun in her element is truly magical.

There are couple of stages I really, really love from yesterday:

1. Seulgi's <Dead Man Runnin'>
The way I couldn't stop myself from screaming, "DAAMNNNN KANG SEULGI" when the stage ended 🤣. I could tell she was a liii~ttle bit nervous, but she managed to overcome it pretty quickly and proceeded to show a super powerful performance 👏🏻

2. Irene's <Kaching> 
To be honest, the song itself is not really up my ally BUUUTTT I could tell that this song is one of Irene's best bet to perform on stage. She clearly enjoyed performing this song so much and there's nothing better than seeing happy, confident performers enjoying themselves on stage🩷

3. <Be Natural> 
While their performance itself was truly captivating, the overall feeling for me was very nostalgic. I remember how I found them super classy and was so impressed when I first watched their video performance as part of SR14G. With 10+ years experience of performing, their stage now looks even cooler🩷💛

4. <Girl Next Door>
Hello, it's me, <Girl Next Door> akgae. 🤣🤣
My expectation was already sky high when I got the spoiler that this song was being put near the end of the whole setlist, but their performance actually exceeded my expectation. Irene's vocals in this concert was amazing but??? In this song??? I was super IMPRESSED. I also looooovveeeee Seulgi's impeccable power vocal+expression control.

5. <Zimzalabim>
It's not Red Velvet's concert without this song 🤣🤣 Happy to finally get another dose of ZZB after R to V in Jakarta (I'm still and will forever be bitter for missing their 10th anniv fancon both in Seoul and Jakarta, btw). I was too tired to jump around but had so much fun singing along 💃🏻🥳

Honorable mention: Tilt, Irresistible, Monster, Like A Flower, Baby Not Baby

The only thing I don't really appreciate is the fact that I had to be in the standing section 😭😭😭 Even worse because I only got to sleep for four hours yesterday because of school stuffs 😭😭

But anyway, overall, it's such a fun experience! So grateful and happy to be able to attend yesterday's concert after such a busy and hectic semester (plus Wendy and Joy were also there muehehe🩵💚)

So excited to see what Red Velvet (in solo, subunit, or group form) has to offer next! 🩷💛🩵💚💜

#GOT7’s #Yugyeom, Final Activity Before Enlistment: “I’m Not Afraid or Sad”

Yugyeom will be releasing his final full-length album before enlisting in the military.

On June 17 at 6 PM (KST), Yugyeom will release his second full album, [#Interlunar].

With his military enlistment approaching, Yugyeom metaphorically expressed the upcoming hiatus through the album title [Interlunar], which means “the period when the moon is not visible between the waning moon and the new moon.” Even if he and his loved ones can’t see each other for a while, knowing that they’ll meet again brings comfort, not fear or sadness. That message runs throughout the album.

The second full album features two title tracks, the eponymous “Interlunar” and “Shall We Dance”, and includes a total of 10 tracks that showcase Yugyeom’s more mature musical style.

Artists with strong individual identities in their respective genres also contributed to producing and featuring on various tracks, including Code Kunst, SEVENTEEN’s Vernon, Gaeko of Dynamic Duo, DJ Wegun, L-like, Hoody, THAMA, and KIRIN, adding to the album’s completeness.

Last year, Yugyeom received global praise with his first full-length solo album [TRUST ME] and the single [Sweet Like]. From October until April this year, he successfully held his solo world tour [TRUSTY], performing in major cities across Asia, North America, and Latin America, including a stop in Seoul.

Just last month, GOT7 reunited as a full group to hold a successful solo concert titled ‘NESTFEST’ in BANGKOK in Thailand.

Yugyeom’s second full album [Interlunar], which sincerely conveys his feelings through well-made music ahead of his enlistment, will be available on major online music platforms starting today (June 17) at 6 PM (KST).

Full Text:
Deboosting Post Projects: The Voldemort Effect

To @Punk9277 Yu hu
Do you know how fandom marketing works in the K-pop industry?

There’s a role called a “Home Master” — a dedicated fan who follows idols to concerts and events with a high-end camera, capturing moments and sometimes selling fan-made goods through their own channels. While unofficial, Home Masters are powerful supporters and creators of user-generated content.

Agencies could see them as a threat, since Home Masters profit from unofficial goods while the agencies rely on official merchandise sales. But most agencies choose to respect and even support them — because they understand that Home Masters are real fans who hold influence within the community. Supporting them ensures long-term growth of the fandom ecosystem.

Lately, it feels like a similar situation is happening in Kaito earn (Especially in Virtual)

Top Kaito Earn rankers who appear frequently on the Post Leaderboard are being punished with what feels like increasing “deboosting.” But ranking high means we genuinely enjoy and actively engage in Kaito yapping — we’re among the most dedicated users of the ecosystem.

And in many cases, I don’t even choose to yap about certain Post projects. If someone tags me alongside the official project account, I end up on the 30D leaderboard regardless of whether I wrote anything — just by being mentioned.

If this continues, unpopular Post projects may turn into Voldemorts — names no one dares to mention.

Please add a feature that lets us turn off projects we don’t want to rank in.

Every pre-TGE project eventually becomes a Post project. If top yappers — those with real influence and loyalty — are discouraged or pushed out of the ecosystem, this could harm Kaito’s long-term sustainability.

Please reconsider how deboosting is applied, and whether it’s aligned with the values of a thriving, inclusive, and creator-respecting ecosystem.

@KaitoAI @virtuals_io
